messages:
alex: Rolling out 0d9f3c9 -> main at 11:12 PST. Post-release alert: p50 latency up ~12% on long-context tails. Noticed more KV cache misses.

tori: :eyes: I saw alerts too. Is this the kernel switch to fused-attn that's in the commit?

sam: Confirming, that commit toggles kernel_selector to prefer fused-attn for seq_len>512. I ran a local perf profile and saw more mem-copies at decode step.

indra: I started a bisect on the canary pool. Early signal points at 0d9f3c9 -> fallback to slower kernel on some shapes.

perf-ci: CI perf test perf/latency-endtoend/long-context failed on the PR, but flaky yesterday. Reproducer: run "pytest -k long_context --runslow".

alex: Bisect result from canary: 0d9f3c9 introduced 9-12% p50 regression on g4dn. Reverted to 7a1b2e4 on canary and p50 returned to baseline.

tori: Is the KV cache eviction policy altered by this? Maybe fused-attn path changes KV layout.

sam: KV layout unchanged but we saw cache line alignment shifts. Profiling snapshot attached:
```
# perf top snippet
memcpy 34.2%
fused_attn_kernel 21.5%
kv_read 12.1%
context_switch 4.3%
```

indra: Action: revert in prod was applied at 11:45. Need root cause and test coverage before reintroducing.

alex: Next steps I propose:
- Add targeted microbench: kernel_selector sanity with mixed seq_len shapes
- Add KV cache regression check: synthetic long-tail hit-rate test
- Tighten CI perf thresholds for long_context test (currently 15% slack -> drop to 8%)
- Add randomized seqlen batcher in perf harness

tori: I'll own the microbench and kernel_selector test. Will add a commit to perf harness.

sam: I'll look at kernel heuristics and check for alignment-induced memcpy. Maybe add an alignment-aware codepath.

perf-ci: Note: lowering threshold will increase false positives. Suggest flagging as "stable-only" for now.

alex: Agree. For rollout: block reintroducing fused-attn until tests land and we've validated on dedicated pools. @indra can you schedule a canary run after tests?

indra: Scheduled 13:30 PST. I'll also attach the bisect log and commit hashes to the incident ticket #INF-312.

tori:+1: Will send PR link when ready.

sam: Repro steps I used are in the snippet. Save them to perf-runbook.

alex: Thanks team. Keeping this thread for rollout decisions. Will update incident when canary finishes.
